reasoning_traces.think:
The core architecture integrates two distinct reasoning engines: JEV (TypeSafe AI) and Gemini Decision 1 (Google's multimodal API). The system uses a hierarchical decomposition strategy where equations are parsed into GuardNodes, SubTermNodes, and GameRuleNodes. GuardNodes determine whether an equation contributes to the final model; SubTermNodes isolate sub-expressions for independent evaluation; and GameRuleNodes encode NFL-specific constraints. These nodes are processed in parallel by `google/gemini-decision-1`, which applies dimensional consistency checks and maps symbols to canonical variables. The resulting structure supports both probabilistic inference and symbolic reasoning. Disagreement between JEV and GD1 outputs triggers conservative shrinkage towards 'PASS' to mitigate liability risk. This dual-engine approach ensures robustness against individual engine failures while maintaining interpretability through structured decomposition.
